page: Microsoft Azure EC64ads_cc_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the AMD EPYC 7763 processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs derived from 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled with 2458 GB of local disk capacity, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core capabilities and memory performance. The instance achieved a top-tier rating in the PassMark memory score and strong results in cached small-block read-only memory bandwidth at 4162.65 GB/sec. Multi-core processing is highly rated, with strong scores in stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. However, uncached large-block memory read and write speeds fall into the average tier, and single-threaded operations, such as gzip compression and Geekbench single-core tests, demonstrate average performance.

The instance exhibits specific performance tradeoffs in machine learning workloads. While prompt processing and text generation for small LLM models are strong, text generation for large models is weak, registering at 2.74 tokens/sec due to the absence of dedicated GPU hardware. Qualitatively, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local storage capacity offer resource density suitable for memory-intensive workloads. This server is configured for database operations, memory-cached applications, and multi-threaded data processing tasks.
